releases.body:
## What's Changed
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/173
* Update template to v0.8.0 by @scverse-bot in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/183
* Make pyreadr an optional dependency to avoid AGPL/BSD license conflict by @govinda-kamath in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/190
* Use pooch for example datasets by @grst in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/193
* Bump the actions-deps group across 1 directory with 5 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/187
* [pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate by @pre-commit-ci[bot] in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/176
* Bump the actions-deps group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/194
* Fix github workflow by @grst in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/195
* build(io): replace pyreadr with rdata by @stephenwilliams22 in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/191
* ci: switch from pre-commit.ci to autofix.ci by @flying-sheep in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/196
* chore: point URLs to scverse, drop changelog stub by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/198
* build: SPEC 0, template update and mypy by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/200
* feat: log through scverse-misc and build the docs with scverse-doc by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/201
* test: fast offline test run, CDN-hosted datasets and heatmap image tests by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/202
* feat!: scanpy 1.13 use/out API, small tool fixes, igraph leiden by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/203
* perf: numba kernels with lazy dask and backed input for tl.infercnv by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/204
* build: pin scanpy below 1.13 and revert the use/out migration by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/205
* perf: numba kernel for tl.ithcna and tl.ithgex by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/206
* feat(tl): n_pairs for ithcna/ithgex, an unbiased estimate from sampled cell pairs by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/207
* perf(pl): draw chromosome heatmaps with infercnvpy's own numba renderer by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/208
* perf: twice as fast tl.infercnv (parallel reference means, fused band and CSR assembly, zero-baseline smoothing) by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/209
* feat: spatial CNV layer (tl.smooth_cnv, tl.spatial_regions, pl.spatial_cnv) and a Xenium tutorial by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/210
* Bump https://github.com/biomejs/pre-commit from v2.6.4 to 2.6.5 in the pre-commit group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/197
* fix: lazy output opt-in, clear errors and warnings, ith self-pairs option, smaller fixes from the docs review by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/211
* refactor: consistent use_rep, use_raw, copy and keyword-only arguments, with deprecations by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/212
* feat(tl): optional min_mean gene filter for tl.infercnv by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/213
* docs: tutorials re-executed with current defaults, reproducible tumour calls, method differences to R inferCNV by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/214
* fix(pl): leave out heatmap labels that would overlap by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/215
* fix: numba cache data files named by key, so concurrent compiles can't mix up signatures by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/216
* fix: correctness fixes from the 0.7.0 code review by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/217
* fix(pl): plotting fixes from the 0.7.0 review by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/218
* refactor: robustness and cleanup fixes from the 0.7.0 review by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/219
* feat(tl): tl.copy_number, clone-level copy number from counts; remove tl.copykat by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/220
* feat(tl): tl.copykat raises an error that points to tl.copy_number by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/222
* tl.copy_number: reference cells stay diploid, spatial neighbor prior, restarts with a stability score, faster PCA and kernels by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/223
* feat: tl.detectability and pl.detectability, per-arm CNV detectability of a panel and depth by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/221
* fix: 15 bugs from the review of #214 to #223, cuts of duplicated code and tests, faster heatmap dendrogram by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/224
* fix: float16 input in copy_number, detectability and smooth_cnv by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/225
* docs: tutorials re-executed for 0.7.0, text from a review by five readers, tumor instead of tumour by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/226
* fix(copy_number): raise on input that is not raw counts by @timtreis in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/227

## New Contributors
* @scverse-bot made their first contribution in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/183
* @govinda-kamath made their first contribution in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/190
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/187
* @stephenwilliams22 made their first contribution in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/191
* @flying-sheep made their first contribution in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/196
* @timtreis made their first contribution in https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/pull/198

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/scverse/infercnvpy/compare/v0.6.1...v0.7.0rc1
